source_manifest.configuration: 16 x 16 NPU, 64-bit bus, 7 shared banks of 8 KiB; PicoRV32 and 256 KiB CPU RAM

resources.counting_method: Each LUT primitive is counted once before packing; LUT RAM and SRL use their architectural LUT storage requirements. Packing may combine compatible logic LUTs or insert routing LUTs. A placed design supplies physical_lut_sites_after_placement.

register_path_requirement.scope: Clocked storage outputs to synchronous data and control inputs
register_path_requirement.timing_frequency_validation: Requires primitive and routing delays for the target device

abc_mapping_delay.scope: ABC 映射阶段的引脚和连线成本模型，实际器件频率须由布线后的完整时序模型检查。

resources_by_source.attribution_method: Original register signal declarations, RTL source attributes and register instance names identify storage and arithmetic owners. Flattened LUTs without source attributes are assigned when all reachable consumer owners agree; shared and unclassified logic are reported separately.

startpoint.detail: DSP internal register followed by unregistered arithmetic

paths.path_method: Connected bit graph from clocked storage to synchronous data/control inputs. LUT6_2 O5 excludes I5, CARRY4 dependencies follow carry direction, and asynchronous memory outputs depend on read addresses. DSP register parameters define clocked boundaries. Arithmetic between an input port and an internal register, between internal registers, or between an internal register and an output port contributes one DSP cell for that connected segment. Direct registered outputs contribute zero arithmetic cells. The identified ONE48 A:B/C ALU mode preserves low-to-high carry direction for P and PCOUT; all other DSP dependencies remain conservative, including the A:B ALU bypass. Counts describe structural depth; primitive and routing delays require device timing analysis.

dsp_mapping.selection_rule: Select 24 to 48 bit arithmetic first, then narrower independent cells; highest estimated area within each group; no combinational path between selected DSP cells or an existing unregistered DSP

dsp_formal.method: Combinational SAT over every defined input; official Yosys $alu and DSP48E1 models
